title: Add SIMD-ready Gray square-QAM batch kernels
description:
Make the Gray square-QAM hot path batch-oriented and compatible with SIMD dispatch and future accelerator backends.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] The Gray-QAM fast path uses batch-oriented data flow rather than per-symbol allocation-heavy code.
- [ ] Memory layout and control flow are structured so SIMD dispatch can plug in cleanly.
- [ ] The kernel boundary is reusable by future accelerator backends without API churn.

## Notes

This task is the performance-focused leaf that prepares the modem path for SIMD and conditional GPU work.
